verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details BugSnag integrations with Slack, PagerDuty, webhooks, and an MCP server, but contains no mention of Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear integration, nor any two-way status sync between tickets and error states. Missing for 10: any documentation of issue-tracker integrations (Jira/GitHub Issues/Linear), evidence of two-way sync, or ticket-resolution-reopens-error behavior.
